    5: Derived from the Path B D2 workshop closure (`sessions/framework/registry/path-b-d2-workshop.md`,

    7: strongly by all three reviewers and most directly grounded in existing framework
    8: infrastructure:

   10: | Round | Verdict on RQ-3 | Anchor |
